slides.headline: CHATGPT NOW READS EVERY APP YOU OPEN AND MOST BUSINESS OWNERS HAVE NO IDEA IT EXISTS
slides.kicker: MOST PEOPLE EXPLAIN FROM SCRATCH EVERY TIME
slides.image_prompt: Desk with giant rubber stamp slamming manila folder; filing cabinets in orange, green, electric blue tower behind; $ and warning triangle symbols visible; white neon OpenAI logo on wall; warm amber light.

slides.headline: 1) CHATGPT NOW WATCHES YOUR SCREEN ALL DAY
slides.body: Computer History, new in the ChatGPT desktop app, reads every app and website you open and carries that context into every future chat. Most business owners don't know it exists.

slides.headline: 2) TELL IT YOUR BUSINESS IN ONE PARAGRAPH
slides.body: ChatGPT's memory stores your context and carries it into every future session. This prompt goes into memory settings once, from that point it stops asking what your company does.

slides.headline: 3) PASTE 3 EMAILS YOU'VE ACTUALLY SENT
slides.body: Telling it to write professionally teaches it nothing. Three real emails you've already sent teach it your sentence rhythm, word choice, and tone, one paste and every draft sounds like you.

slides.headline: 4) GIVE IT YOUR 5 HARD RULES
slides.body: Without rules in memory, ChatGPT optimizes for the average client in your industry. One wrong recommendation to a real client can cost you the relationship.

slides.headline: 5) DESCRIBE YOUR PERFECT CUSTOMER
slides.body: The gap between a generic output and one your clients call weirdly accurate is one paragraph stored in memory. This prompt is that paragraph.

slides.headline: 6) TELL IT WHO YOU'RE COMPETING AGAINST
slides.body: ChatGPT has no idea what your competitors say until you tell it. Without this in memory, the copy it writes for you could just as easily belong to any rival in your space.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You'll want these when you sit down tonight. Paste them into memory one by one and ChatGPT becomes a different tool by tomorrow morning. Daily AI skills and real news, right here

caption:
Swipe to grab all 6 before your next session. ChatGPT's new memory can turn it from a tool that forgets you into one that already knows your whole business. 🧠

Computer History: the new desktop feature that watches your apps all day and names what to automate first. Business overview: one paragraph that stops it from asking what you do. Writing voice: 3 real emails that teach it your exact style. Hard rules: 5 non-negotiables it filters every answer through. Customer profile: one paragraph that makes every output sound personally written. Competitor map: the names and pitches it needs to point your copy away from.

ChatGPT can now see what you actually work on, not just what you type. Combined with memory, it holds your business context permanently. Owners who set this up stop explaining themselves in every session.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

candidates: 6 INPUTS THAT MAKE CHATGPT KNOW YOUR BUSINESS BETTER THAN MOST EMPLOYEES
6 THINGS TO TELL CHATGPT MOST BUSINESS OWNERS NEVER DO
